approval: Aprobado para regresión de software tras revisión técnica reproducible; no es validación empírica ni aprobación metodológica del modelo.

metricUnits.gdp: miles de millones de euros del año de partida, ritmo anualizado
metricUnits.purchasingPower: euros por persona y año, media de hogares simulados
metricUnits.inflation: porcentaje interanual frente al mismo mes del año anterior
metricUnits.debtRatio: deuda al cierre / PIB nominal anualizado, porcentaje
metricUnits.investment: miles de millones de euros del año de partida, flujo anualizado

tolerance: Raw CSV numbers are asserted at 1e-9 relative tolerance; rendered table/cards use half their last displayed digit (±0.05, purchasing power ±0.5).

candidateReview.method: Candidate values were exported through the browser UI (CSV action) on two clean Chromium profiles using HTTP, the production build, native Worker and IndexedDB. No session import or direct engine call produced the candidate.
review: Month 12 and month 60 match the already-approved P04 snapshot for the friction branch and the baseline branch across all six metrics; this verifies the recipe and branch correspondence.
The documented first-step friction factor is exp(-3 × 0.04) = 0.8869204367171575; the test does not assert an unsupported equal reduction in total realized investment.
The documented capacity lag remains applicable: this golden records the 120-month output and does not change the model's lag interpretation.
The two independent UI runs returned identical raw month-120 rows.
candidateReview.reviewer: Codex technical review; no independent human sign-off was provided.
candidateReview.limitations: Approval fixes a reproducible application result for regression. It does not validate the economic assumptions, causal interpretation, or empirical plausibility.
